issues.problem: pt-nda and pt-mono examples wrote traffic congestion as 道が込んでいた; modern standard spelling (NHK, newspapers) is 混んでいた.
issues.action: Changed 込[こ]んで to 混[こ]んで in both examples.

issues.problem: pt-wake mistake: 足を怪我したので、走るわけにはいかない is not really wrong; natives say it to mean 'I mustn't run (it would make things worse)'.
issues.action: Replaced with a clear lack-of-ability case: この漢字は難しくて、読むわけにはいかない → 読めない.

issues.problem: pt-mono explain said nostalgic たものだ 'cannot describe a single event' without mentioning the exclamation use (よく頑張ったものだ), so the rule was false as stated.
issues.action: Qualified the sentence: an ordinary single event is excluded; with a single event it appears only in exclamations such as よく頑張ったものだ.

issues.problem: x-pt-wake example 鍵を持っていなかったのか。入れなかったわけだ。 is abrupt without a linking word; the English 'So that's why' was not reflected.
issues.action: Added それで: それで入れなかったわけだ。
